title: Port Conflict
description:
$ ./api
listen tcp 127.0.0.1:8080: bind: address already in use
mission: Identify the CLI Quest process listening on TCP port 8080 and stop it so the port becomes available.

files.content: The API needs TCP port 8080. Do not kill unrelated system processes.

hints: Find which process is listening on TCP port 8080.
On macOS and many Linux systems, lsof -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN shows the PID.
Inspect the PID, confirm it is the cliquest helper, then terminate that PID with kill.
